about: Law Office of Domingo Garcia is a personal injury firm with four offices across Texas, including Houston, Dallas and Fort Worth.
The firm states that it works on a contingency fee, with nothing to pay unless the case is won; the first consultation is free. It publishes material in English and Spanish.

completeness.note: Categories, opening hours, photo count and description come from the Places API. The services list, the Q&A and recent posts are owner-side fields the API does not expose at any price, so they are not scored either way.

subs.label: Authentic volume
subs.evidence: 5,654 Google reviews · Google Business Profile via Places API. 4 listings, counts summed and rating weighted by count

subs.label: Rating quality
subs.evidence: Google rating 4.76 over 5,654 reviews → Bayesian 4.76 (prior 4.83 weighted as 100 reviews, from 528 scored firms) · single platform, Google only

subs.label: Review recency
subs.evidence: 19 of 20 sampled reviews are from the last 12 months (newest 2026-08-06) · a sample of five per business listing, not every review

subs.label: Complaint share
subs.evidence: 2 of 20 sampled reviews rate 1 or 2 stars · a sample, so this is the shape of the complaints rather than a count of them

subs.label: Website trust & experience
subs.evidence: CWV fail · no bar numbers on bios · no fee statement · privacy policy · no disclaimer · fresh content

subs.label: Search authority
subs.evidence: DR 18 → 46th pct of 74-firm cohort (median 19) 1/3 · 909 referring domains, 34th pct 1/2 · 615 organic keywords / 14,046 visits·mo, 91th pct 2/2 · brand demand 0/1 (pending)

subs.label: Local presence
subs.evidence: 4 operational Google Business Profile listings · 10 or more photos, which is where the API stops counting · 5 categories, hours published, which almost every listing here has and so separates nobody · the services list, Q&A and recent posts are owner-side fields the Places API does not expose, and NAP consistency across citations and local-pack rank have no source here, so the rest of this sub-factor leaves the scale rather than being scored as unearned

subs.label: Content, E-E-A-T & schema
subs.evidence: JSON-LD detected 1/1 · not assessed on any firm yet, so content depth and earned media and AI citations leave the scale (4 pts)
